description.value: You gain the saber throw force power without it counting against your powers known. You no longer suffer disadvantage on its attack roll merely for standing within 5 feet of a hostile creature, and when you cast it as your action and hit, you may apply your Double Strike Force-Empowered Self option. Additionally, when the power connects and its damage doesn't already include your Wisdom or Charisma modifier, you add half that modifier (your choice, minimum +1) to the damage dealt.
